note: Draft set for the end-to-end clinical run. Expected answers are NOT filled in: they must be taken from approved documents in the TEST repository and reviewed by an MSL ('needs MSL review'). Run with scripts/run_clinical_demo.py.
documents_needed: Approved prescribing information (label) for aflibercept (EYLEA or equivalent), public version
Approved prescribing information (label) for faricimab (VABYSMO), public version
A published guideline on diabetic retinopathy / diabetic macular edema (for example an AAO Preferred Practice Pattern)
For the 'conflicting' case: two approved documents that give different values for the same statement (a planted pair is fine in the TEST repository only)

questions.text: What dosing interval does the approved label give for aflibercept in diabetic macular edema?

How does the approved faricimab label describe its mechanism of action?
What does the guideline say about monitoring frequency for diabetic macular edema?
What is the price of one faricimab injection in India?
Is there data on aflibercept in children with congenital glaucoma?
What is the stated loading-dose schedule for the planted conflicting document pair?

What is the best first-line therapy for stage III NSCLC?
